D1Bound5/BennettPositiveSeries.lean:
import D1Bound5.BennettResidualMajorant
import D1Bound5.BennettPoleSeries
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Ring.InfiniteSum
import Mathlib.Topology.Algebra.InfiniteSum.Order
import Mathlib.Tactic.FieldSimp

open Finset

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The coefficientwise absolute majorant of an actual local pole factor.
Writing the coefficients explicitly avoids any implicit choice of signs. -/
noncomputable def bennettPoleMajorant (d : ℝ) (p : ℕ) : PowerSeries ℝ :=
  PowerSeries.mk (fun n => |Ring.choose (-(p : ℝ)) n| * (d⁻¹) ^ (p + n))

@[simp] theorem bennettPoleMajorant_coeff (d : ℝ) (p n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d p) =
      |Ring.choose (-(p : ℝ)) n| * (d⁻¹) ^ (p + n) := by
  exact PowerSeries.coeff_mk _ _

theorem bennettPoleMajorant_coeff_nonneg (d : ℝ) (hd : 0 ≤ d) (p n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d p) := by
  rw [bennettPoleMajorant_coeff]
  exact mul_nonneg (abs_nonneg _) (pow_nonneg (inv_nonneg.mpr hd) _)

/-- The majorant coefficients equal the norms of the actual complex pole
series coefficients, with exactly the same pole order and displacement. -/
theorem bennettPoleSeries_coeff_norm_eq_majorant (z : ℂ) (p n : ℕ) :
    ‖PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleSeries z p)‖ =
      PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant ‖z‖ p) := by
  have hcast : Ring.choose (-(p : ℂ)) n = (Ring.choose (-(p : ℝ)) n : ℂ) := by
    simpa using (Ring.map_choose (algebraMap ℝ ℂ) (-(p : ℝ)) n).symm
  rw [bennettPoleSeries_coeff, norm_mul, norm_pow, norm_inv,
    bennettPoleMajorant_coeff, hcast, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs]

/-- The actual weighted sum of the positive pole majorant, including pole
order zero. The radius is strictly smaller than the positive displacement. -/
theorem bennettPoleMajorant_hasSum
    (d r : ℝ) (p : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (hr0 : 0 ≤ r) (hrd : r < d) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d p) * r ^ n)
      ((d-r)⁻¹ ^ p) := by
  cases p with
  | zero =>
      convert (hasSum_ite_eq (0 : ℕ) (1 : ℝ)) using 1
      · ext n
        by_cases hn : n = 0
        · subst n
          simp
        · simp [bennettPoleMajorant_coeff, Ring.choose_zero_ite, hn]
      · simp
  | succ p =>
      have hratio0 : 0 ≤ r/d := div_nonneg hr0 hd.le
      have hratio1 : r/d < 1 := (div_lt_one hd).2 hrd
      have hp : (0 : ℝ) < ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) := by positivity
      have hs := bennett_negative_binomial_abs_hasSum
        ((p + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) (r/d) hp hratio0 hratio1
      have hscaled := hs.mul_left (d⁻¹ ^ (p+1))
      have hbase : 0 < 1-r/d := sub_pos.mpr hratio1
      have hsub : 0 < d-r := sub_pos.mpr hrd
      have hinner : d⁻¹*(1-r/d)⁻¹ = (d-r)⁻¹ := by
        field_simp [hd.ne', hbase.ne', hsub.ne'] <;> ring
      have htotal : d⁻¹ ^ (p+1) * (1/(1-r/d)^((p+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) =
          (d-r)⁻¹ ^ (p+1) := by
        rw [Real.rpow_natCast]
        calc
          _ = (d⁻¹ * (1-r/d)⁻¹) ^ (p+1) := by
            simp only [mul_pow, inv_pow, one_div]
          _ = _ := by rw [hinner]
      rw [htotal] at hscaled
      have hfun :
          (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d (p+1)) * r^n) =
          (fun n : ℕ => d⁻¹ ^ (p+1) *
            (|Ring.choose (-((p+1 : ℕ) : ℝ)) n| * (r/d)^n)) := by
        funext n
        simp only [bennettPoleMajorant_coeff, pow_add, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_pow]
        ring
      rw [hfun]
      exact hscaled

/-- Multiplying two series with nonnegative coefficients preserves
coefficient nonnegativity. -/
theorem bennett_positive_coeff_mul
    (P Q : PowerSeries ℝ)
    (hP : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n P)
    (hQ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n Q) (n : ℕ) :
    0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n (P*Q) := by
  rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul]
  exact Finset.sum_nonneg (fun ij _ => mul_nonneg (hP ij.1) (hQ ij.2))

/-- Weighted Cauchy multiplication for positive real power series. The two
series are actually summable at the chosen radius; no formal evaluation is
silently treated as an analytic sum. -/
theorem bennett_positive_series_mul_hasSum
    (P Q : PowerSeries ℝ) (r s t : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hP : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n P)
    (hQ : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n Q)
    (hs : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n) s)
    (ht : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n Q * r^n) t) :
    HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (P*Q) * r^n) (s*t) := by
  have hprod := hs.summable.mul_of_nonneg ht.summable
    (fun n => mul_nonneg (hP n) (pow_nonneg hr n))
    (fun n => mul_nonneg (hQ n) (pow_nonneg hr n))
  have hsum := summable_sum_mul_antidiagonal_of_summable_mul hprod
  have heq := hs.summable.tsum_mul_tsum_eq_tsum_sum_antidiagonal ht.summable hprod
  rw [hs.tsum_eq, ht.tsum_eq] at heq
  have hcoeff :
      (fun n : ℕ => ∑ ij ∈ Finset.antidiagonal n,
        (PowerSeries.coeff ij.1 P*r^ij.1) * (PowerSeries.coeff ij.2 Q*r^ij.2)) =
      (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n (P*Q)*r^n) := by
    funext n
    rw [PowerSeries.coeff_mul, Finset.sum_mul]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro ij hij
    have hsumij := Finset.mem_antidiagonal.mp hij
    rw [← hsumij, pow_add]
    ring
  rw [hcoeff] at hsum heq
  simpa only [← heq] using hsum.hasSum

/-- Every nonnegative weighted coefficient is bounded by the actual sum. -/
theorem bennett_positive_series_coeff_le_sum
    (P : PowerSeries ℝ) (r s : ℝ) (hr : 0 ≤ r)
    (hP : ∀ n, 0 ≤ PowerSeries.coeff n P)
    (hs : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n) s) (n : ℕ) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n P * r^n ≤ s := by
  rw [← hs.tsum_eq]
  exact hs.summable.le_tsum n
    (fun m _ => mul_nonneg (hP m) (pow_nonneg hr m))

/-- A useful ready-to-apply two-pole coefficient bound. -/
theorem bennett_two_pole_majorant_coeff_le
    (d e r : ℝ) (p q n : ℕ) (hd : 0 < d) (he : 0 < e)
    (hr : 0 ≤ r) (hrd : r < d) (hre : r < e) :
    PowerSeries.coeff n (bennettPoleMajorant d p * bennettPoleMajorant e q) * r^n ≤
      (d-r)⁻¹ ^ p * (e-r)⁻¹ ^ q := by
  have hP := bennettPoleMajorant_coeff_nonneg d hd.le p
  have hQ := bennettPoleMajorant_coeff_nonneg e he.le q
  exact bennett_positive_series_coeff_le_sum _ _ _ hr
    (bennett_positive_coeff_mul _ _ hP hQ)
    (bennett_positive_series_mul_hasSum _ _ _ _ _ hr hP hQ
      (bennettPoleMajorant_hasSum d r p hd hr hrd)
      (bennettPoleMajorant_hasSum e r q he hr hre)) n

end D1Bound5

import D1Bound5.CoherentRetainedMixedForms
import D1Bound5.CoherentRetainedAnalyticData
import D1Bound5.RetainedMixedScalar

open Finset
open scoped NumberField
open Module

namespace D1Bound5

/-- The retained coefficient remains greater than one when the first
anchor has modulus only one, for either manuscript interpolation row. -/
theorem coherent_retained_mixed_coefficient_gt_one
    (A B R lam : ℝ) (hA : 1 ≤ A) (hB : 3 ≤ B) (hR : 0 < R) (hR8 : R ≤ 8)
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (hlam10 : lam ≤ 1/10) :
    1 < (9999/10000 : ℝ)/lam^2 *
      (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))^2 := by
  have hAB : (9 : ℝ) ≤ A^2*B^2 := by
    calc
      (9 : ℝ) = 1^2*3^2 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ A^2*B^2 := by gcongr <;> first | assumption | norm_num
  have hAB0 : 0 < A^2*B^2 := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hAB
  have hinv : (1/8 : ℝ) ≤ 1/R := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 8) hR).2
    simpa using hR8
  have herr : (51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2) ≤ (51051/400000)/9 := by
    apply (div_le_div_iff₀ hAB0 (by norm_num : (0 : ℝ) < 9)).2
    nlinarith only [hAB]
  have hd : (11/100 : ℝ) < 1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2) := by
    linarith only [hinv,herr]
  have hs : (11/100 : ℝ)^2 < (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))^2 := by
    have hp := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hd)
      (show 0 < (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2))+(11/100) by linarith only [hd])
    nlinarith only [hp]
  have hlamsq : lam^2 ≤ (1/100 : ℝ) := by
    have hh := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr hlam10)
      (show 0 ≤ 1/10+lam by positivity)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hc : (9999/100 : ℝ) ≤ (9999/10000)/lam^2 := by
    apply (le_div_iff₀ (pow_pos hlam 2)).2
    nlinarith only [hlamsq]
  have hh := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hc
    (sq_nonneg (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(A^2*B^2)))
  nlinarith only [hs,hh]

/-- Precise and basic retained gaps in the mixed regime for actual
five tuple entries. Both H32 and H48 are available. The frontier and
product hypotheses are explicit tuple growth estimates, subsequently
discharged by the actual small-norm frontier theorem. -/
theorem full_ring_retained_three_mixed_gap
    {K : Type*} [Field K] [NumberField K] [NumberField.IsTotallyComplex K]
    (hK : finrank ℚ K = 2) (phi : K →+* ℂ)
    {Tup : Finset (𝓞 K)} (hTup : IsD1 Tup)
    (a : Fin 5 → 𝓞 K) (hinj : Function.Injective a) (hmem : ∀ i, a i ∈ Tup)
    (hA : 1 ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖) (hB : 3 ≤ ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖)
    (hAB : ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖)
    (hBS : ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖ ≤ ‖phi (a 2 : K)‖)
    (hfrontier : 2*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 3 : K)‖)
    (hproduct : 3*‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖ < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖)
    (H lam U : ℝ) (hrow : CoherentRetainedRow H lam U)
    (hAT : H ≤ ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖) :
    let v : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => phi (a (![0,1,2] i) : K)
    let R := ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖/(‖phi (a 1 : K)‖*‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2)
    (9999/10000 : ℝ)/lam^2 *
      (1/R-(51051/400000 : ℝ)/(‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^2*‖phi (a 1 : K)‖^2))^2 *
        (‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^2*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖^5/‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2) < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖ ∧
      ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖^2*‖phi (a 3 : K)‖^5/‖phi (a 2 : K)‖^2 < ‖phi (a 4 : K)‖ := by
  let f : 𝓞 K →+* ℂ := phi.comp (algebraMap (𝓞 K) K)
  let v : Fin 3 → ℂ := fun i => f (a (![0,1,2] i))
  let A := ‖f (a 0)‖
  let B := ‖f (a 1)‖
  let S := ‖f (a 2)‖
  let P := ‖f (a 3)‖
  let C := ‖f (a 4)‖
  let eta : ℂ := (f (a 3)*f (a 4))^(1/2 : ℂ)
  let Z := ‖coherentTerminalRoot (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta‖
  let L := coherentQuotientForm v (coherentVandermonde3 v) (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta
  let R := ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖/(B*S^2)
  have hA0 : 0 < A := by change 0 < ‖phi (a 0 : K)‖; linarith only [hA]
  have hB0 : 0 < B := by change 0 < ‖phi (a 1 : K)‖; linarith only [hB]
  have hS3 : 3 ≤ S := hB.trans hBS
  have hS0 : 0 < S := by linarith only [hS3]
  have hP0 : 0 < P := lt_trans (by positivity : 0 < 2*A*B*S) hfrontier
  have hH32 : 32 ≤ H := by
    rcases hrow with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ <;> norm_num
  have hparams := coherent_retained_mixed_size_parameters A B S P C
    hA hB hBS (hH32.trans hAT) hfrontier hproduct
  have hC0 : 0 < C := by nlinarith only [hparams.2.2.2.1,hP0]
  have hSP : S ≤ P := by nlinarith only [hparams.1,hS0]
  have heta : eta^2 = f (a 3)*f (a 4) := coherent_cpow_half_sq _
  have hactual := full_ring_retained_three_mixed_lower_upper hK phi hTup a hinj hmem
    hA hB hAB hBS hfrontier hproduct H lam U hrow hAT eta heta
  have hf : Function.Injective f := by
    intro x y hxy
    apply NumberField.RingOfIntegers.ext
    exact phi.injective hxy
  have hv : Function.Injective v :=
    hf.comp (hinj.comp (by decide : Function.Injective (![0,1,2] : Fin 3 → Fin 5)))
  have hratio := coherent_three_vandermonde_ratio_bounds v hv hA0 hAB hBS
  have hroots := coherent_terminal_root_norm_sq_bounds (f (a 3)) (f (a 4)) eta
    (norm_pos_iff.mp hP0) (norm_pos_iff.mp hC0) heta
    (by linarith only [hparams.2.2.2.2.1])
  have hZ : 0 < Z := by
    have hz0 : 0 ≤ Z := norm_nonneg _
    have hpos : 0 < (3999/4000 : ℝ)*P*C := by positivity
    nlinarith only [hz0,hpos,hroots.1]
  have hdelta : R*B*S^2 = ‖coherentVandermonde3 v‖ := by
    dsimp [R]
    field_simp <;> ring
  have hupper : ‖L‖ < 51*(R*B*S^2)/(100*Z) +
      lam*(R*B*S^2)*Z/(A*B*S*P^3) := by
    rw [hdelta]
    exact hactual.2.2.2
  have hlam : 0 < lam ∧ lam ≤ 1/10 := by
    rcases hrow with ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ | ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl⟩ <;> norm_num
  have hret := retained_three_mixed_scalar_gap A B S P C Z R ‖L‖ lam
    hA hB hS3 hSP hZ hratio.1 hratio.2 hlam.1 hlam.2 hfrontier hactual.1
    hroots.1 hroots.2 hactual.2.2.1 hupper
  have hc := coherent_retained_mixed_coefficient_gt_one A B R lam
    hA hB hratio.1 hratio.2 hlam.1 hlam.2
  have hbase : 0 < A^2*P^5/S^2 := by positivity
  have hh := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hc hbase
  exact ⟨hret,(by simpa only [one_mul] using hh).trans hret⟩

end D1Bound5

/-- The ordinary height envelope, proved directly from all integer-order
inequalities. Its hypotheses expose precisely the analytic input; the
full-ring wrapper supplies that input from the actual Bennett matrix. -/
theorem ordinary_height_envelope_from_orders
    (B C D Z R h r u : ℝ)
    (hB : 1 ≤ B) (hC : 1 < C) (hD : 0 < D) (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hR : 0 < R)
    (hprod : C*D < 2*Z^2)
    (hHlog : ordinaryLog10 (42*B^3*C) < ordinaryLog10 C+h)
    (hRlog : 2*ordinaryLog10 C+r < ordinaryLog10 R)
    (hUlog : ordinaryLog10 (253*B^2) < u)
    (hxt : h-r < ordinaryLog10 C) (hx2 : 0 < 2*ordinaryLog10 C+r)
    (horders : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k →
      1 < 3*C*(42*B^3*C)^k/(B*Z)+Z/(2*R^k)) :
    ordinaryLog10 D < 7*ordinaryLog10 C+(4*u+8*h-4*r)+
      (2*u*r+(4*u+8*h-4*r)*(h-r))/(ordinaryLog10 C-(h-r))+(2/5 : ℝ) := by
  let H := 42*B^3*C
  let X := 3*C/B
  let x := ordinaryLog10 C
  let z := ordinaryLog10 Z
  let p := ordinaryLog10 R
  let q := ordinaryLog10 H
  let L := Real.log (10 : ℝ)
  have hB0 : 0 < B := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hB
  have hC0 : 0 < C := lt_trans (by norm_num) hC
  have hZ0 : 0 < Z := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hZ
  have hL : 0 < L := ordinaryLog10_base_pos
  have hB3 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ B^3 := by
    calc
      1 = (1 : ℝ)^3 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ B^3 := by gcongr
  have hH : 1 ≤ H := by
    calc
      1 ≤ (42 : ℝ)*1*1 := by norm_num
      _ ≤ H := by dsimp [H]; gcongr
  have hH0 : 0 < H := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hH
  have hX : 0 < X := by dsimp [X]; positivity
  have hp0 : 0 < p := hx2.trans hRlog
  have hlR : 0 < Real.log R := by
    have hh := (lt_div_iff₀ hL).mp hp0
    simpa only [zero_mul] using hh
  have hR1 : 1 < R := (Real.log_pos_iff hR.le).mp hlR
  have hi := ordinary_integer_orders_log_bound H R Z X hH hR1 hZ hX
    (by
      intro k hk
      have heq : X*H^k/Z = 3*C*H^k/(B*Z) := by
        dsimp [X]
        field_simp [hB0.ne',hZ0.ne'] <;> ring
      rw [heq]
      exact horders k hk)
  have hscaled : z*(p-q) < (Real.log (2*X*H)/L)*p := by
    have hh := div_lt_div_of_pos_right hi (sq_pos_of_pos hL)
    convert hh using 1 <;> dsimp [z,p,q,L,ordinaryLog10]
    all_goals field_simp [ordinaryLog10_base_pos.ne']
    all_goals ring
  have hnumid : 2*X*H = 252*B^2*C^2 := by
    dsimp [X,H]
    field_simp [hB0.ne'] <;> ring
  have hnumlt : 2*X*H < 253*B^2*C^2 := by
    rw [hnumid]
    have hh := mul_pos (sq_pos_of_pos hB0) (sq_pos_of_pos hC0)
    nlinarith only [hh]
  have hnumlog : Real.log (2*X*H)/L < 2*x+u := by
    have hh := ordinaryLog10_strictMono (by positivity : 0 < 2*X*H) hnumlt
    rw [ordinaryLog10_mul (253*B^2) (C^2) (by positivity) (by positivity),
      ordinaryLog10_pow] at hh
    change ordinaryLog10 (2*X*H) < 2*ordinaryLog10 C+u
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
    linarith only [hh,hUlog]
  have hbound : z*(p-q) < (2*x+u)*p :=
    hscaled.trans (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hnumlog hp0)
  have hdlog : ordinaryLog10 D < (2/5 : ℝ)-x+2*z := by
    have hh := ordinaryLog10_strictMono (mul_pos hC0 hD) hprod
    rw [ordinaryLog10_mul C D hC0.ne' hD.ne',
      ordinaryLog10_mul 2 (Z^2) (by norm_num) (by positivity),
      ordinaryLog10_pow] at hh
    norm_num only [Nat.cast_ofNat] at hh
    have htwo := ordinaryLog10_two_lt
    change ordinaryLog10 D < (2/5 : ℝ)-ordinaryLog10 C+2*ordinaryLog10 Z
    linarith only [hh,htwo]
  exact ordinary_height_scalar_envelope x z (ordinaryLog10 D) p q h r u
    (ordinaryLog10_nonneg hZ) (ordinaryLog10_nonneg hH)
    hRlog hx2 hHlog hxt hbound hdlog

end D1Bound5

/-- Selecting the actual positive integer order from the logarithmic
floor gives a division-free logarithmic inequality. This is the scalar
step from all integer orders to the ordinary height envelope. -/
theorem ordinary_integer_orders_log_bound (H R Z X : ℝ)
    (hH : 1 ≤ H) (hR : 1 < R) (hZ : 1 ≤ Z) (hX : 0 < X)
    (horders : ∀ k : ℕ, 1 ≤ k → 1 < X*H^k/Z+Z/(2*R^k)) :
    Real.log Z*(Real.log R-Real.log H) < Real.log (2*X*H)*Real.log R := by
  have hH0 : 0 < H := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hH
  have hR0 : 0 < R := lt_trans (by norm_num) hR
  have hZ0 : 0 < Z := lt_of_lt_of_le (by norm_num) hZ
  have hlR : 0 < Real.log R := Real.log_pos hR
  have hlH : 0 ≤ Real.log H := Real.log_nonneg hH
  have hlZ : 0 ≤ Real.log Z := Real.log_nonneg hZ
  let k : ℕ := ⌊Real.log Z/Real.log R⌋₊+1
  have hk : 1 ≤ k := by dsimp [k]; omega
  have hklo : Real.log Z < (k : ℝ)*Real.log R := by
    have h := Nat.lt_floor_add_one (Real.log Z/Real.log R)
    have h' : Real.log Z/Real.log R < (k : ℝ) := by
      simpa only [k,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using h
    exact (div_lt_iff₀ hlR).mp h'
  have hkhi : (k : ℝ)*Real.log R ≤ Real.log Z+Real.log R := by
    have h := Nat.floor_le (div_nonneg hlZ hlR.le)
    have h' : (k : ℝ) ≤ Real.log Z/Real.log R+1 := by
      simp only [k,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      linarith only [h]
    have hm := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right h' hlR.le
    have heq : (Real.log Z/Real.log R+1)*Real.log R = Real.log Z+Real.log R := by
      field_simp [hlR.ne']

    apply (Real.log_lt_log_iff hZ0 (pow_pos hR0 k)).mp
    simpa only [Real.log_pow] using hklo
  have hres : Z/(2*R^k) < (1/2 : ℝ) := by
    apply (div_lt_iff₀ (by positivity : 0 < 2*R^k)).mpr
    nlinarith only [hZR]
  have hfirst : (1/2 : ℝ) < X*H^k/Z := by
    have h := horders k hk
    linarith only [h,hres]
  have hheight : Z < 2*X*H^k := by
    have h := (lt_div_iff₀ hZ0).mp hfirst
    nlinarith only [h]
  have hlog := Real.log_lt_log hZ0 hheight
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity : (2:ℝ)*X ≠ 0) (pow_ne_zero k hH0.ne'),
    Real.log_pow] at hlog

  have hq := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hkhi hlH
  rw [Real.log_mul (by positivity : (2:ℝ)*X ≠ 0) hH0.ne']
  nlinarith only [hp,hq]

/-- The exact rational-parameter algebra of the ordinary height
envelope. Here x,z,d are base-ten logarithms and p,q are the residual
rate and coefficient-height logarithms. -/
theorem ordinary_height_scalar_envelope (x z d p q h r u : ℝ)
    (hz : 0 ≤ z) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hp : 2*x+r < p) (hp0 : 0 < 2*x+r)
    (hqh : q < x+h) (hxt : h-r < x)
    (hbound : z*(p-q) < (2*x+u)*p)
    (hd : d < (2/5 : ℝ)-x+2*z) :
    d < 7*x+(4*u+8*h-4*r)+
      (2*u*r+(4*u+8*h-4*r)*(h-r))/(x-(h-r))+(2/5 : ℝ) := by
  have hpPos : 0 < p := hp0.trans hp
  have hxPos : 0 < x-(h-r) := sub_pos.mpr hxt
  have hHpos : 0 < x+h := hq.trans_lt hqh
  have hprod1 := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hp) hHpos
  have hprod2 := mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hqh) hp0
  have hratio : p*(x-(h-r)) < (p-q)*(2*x+r) := by
    nlinarith only [hprod1,hprod2]
  have hlo := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hratio.le hz
  have hhi := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hbound hp0
  have hzmul : z*(x-(h-r)) < (2*x+u)*(2*x+r) := by
    by_contra hbad
    have hm := mul_nonneg (sub_nonneg.mpr (le_of_not_gt hbad)) hpPos.le
    nlinarith only [hlo,hhi,hm]
  have hzupper : z < (2*x+u)*(2*x+r)/(x-(h-r)) :=
    (lt_div_iff₀ hxPos).mpr hzmul
  have hid : (2/5 : ℝ)-x+2*((2*x+u)*(2*x+r)/(x-(h-r))) =
      7*x+(4*u+8*h-4*r)+
        (2*u*r+(4*u+8*h-4*r)*(h-r))/(x-(h-r))+(2/5 : ℝ) := by
    field_simp [hxPos.ne'] <;> ring
  rw [← hid]
  linarith only [hd,hzupper]

/-- Exact scalar contradiction used in the unit-pair branch. The
reciprocal is decreasing on x>=4, so no calculus is necessary. -/
theorem unit_pair_height_cutoff_scalar (s d : ℝ) (hs : 4 ≤ s)
    (hlower : 27*s-4 < d)
    (hupper : d < 7*s+617/25+(118401/2500)/(s-203/100)) : False := by
  have hden : 0 < s-(203/100 : ℝ) := by linarith only [hs]
  have hinv : (118401/2500 : ℝ)/(s-203/100) ≤ 118401/4925 := by
    apply (div_le_iff₀ hden).mpr
    nlinarith only [hs]
  linarith only [hs,hlower,hupper,hinv]

end D1Bound5
